values.note: Online reservations preferred (the center's RV page links its RoverPass booking page); also in person or by phone, 904-255-4254, 8 am-3 pm Mon-Fri. All payments final, no refunds; up to 6 occupants and 1 RV/trailer with pull vehicle per site.

booking.source: https://jaxequestriancenter.com/rv-reservations/ (booking link to RoverPass; 'Phone: (904) 255-4254') + https://jaxequestriancenter.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/JEC-RV-Rules.pdf ('Online reservations are preferred, however, if needed, may be made in person, or by telephone (8am-3pm Mon-Fri)'; 'All payments are final - no refunds for any reason'; 'Maximum of 6 occupants per site'; 'Campsite occupancy is limited to 1 trailer with pull vehicle'), read 2026-10-21

note: City of Jacksonville equestrian center at 13611 Normandy Blvd, run since 2014 by the non-profit Northeast Florida Equestrian Society. RV site rental does not include use of the equestrian center, and no horses are allowed in the RV lots; the outside restroom by the main arena is open around the clock; swimming and fishing are prohibited on the property. --Claude
summary: Center's RV page + 2025 campground rules PDF reconfirm the recorded 30/50-amp full hookups, 50-amp W/E and primitive sites, dump, showers and online (RoverPass) booking; added the operator's RoverPass booking deep link and the rules (phone hours, no refunds, occupancy). Fees (RoverPass, read 2026-10-14) left as recorded. Not a horse-only camp: the rules say RV site rental does not include use of the equestrian center and bar horses from the RV lots. Note trimmed of hookups, lengths, pull-throughs and facilities.
